Muthoot Finance has also reported a significant rise in overdue loans tied to repayment structure changes.

items.title: Scans suggest Rob Roy's gravestone has carvings 1,000 years older than him

items.description: A recent study has uncovered that the gravestone of Rob Roy MacGregor, found at Balquhidder Parish Church, has roots that stretch back an astonishing thousand years prior to his life. For those intrigued, digital models have been made publicly accessible for exploration.

items.title: Barbara Hepworth sculpture given to doctor may fetch £80,000 at auction
items.author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
items.description: Barbara Hepworth's miniature sculpture of Winged Figure, a personal gift to Dr. Roger Slack, is returning to auction. Roger Slack's relationship with Hepworth grew out of their doctor-patient dynamic within the arts community in St Ives. The sculpture reflects Hepworth's artistic legacy and her significant public work on Oxford Street.
